title: Koxinga forces the Dutch to surrender Taiwan
summary: After a nine-month siege, the Dutch governor Frederick Coyett signed the surrender of Fort Zeelandia to the Ming loyalist commander Koxinga.
reason: Koxinga, losing the war against the Qing on the mainland, needed a secure base and attacked the Dutch colony on Taiwan.
significance: It ended Dutch rule in Taiwan and began Chinese settlement of the island under the Kingdom of Tungning.
